authentication: Existing bearer access token; every mutation requires x-fleetora-company-context matching authenticated company. Existing standard success wrapper {success,data,timestamp} applies.
money: All monetary request/response amounts are decimal strings. ILS/USD/EUR precision=2, JOD precision=3. Never JSON numbers. Stored integer minor units.
list: {companyId,items,page,pageSize,hasNext}; query page=1,pageSize=25 (max 100), search?,merchantId?,workerId?,status?,city?,from?,to?. Parcel sorting: sort=createdAt|trackingNumber|scheduledAt, direction=asc|desc (defaults createdAt/desc). Date-only from/to normalize to start/end UTC day; reversed ranges rejected.
merchantInput: name,contactName,phone,pickupAddress,city,currency,deliveryFee,feePayer,returnFee,serviceFee required; secondaryPhone,latitude,longitude,notes,paymentNotes optional; active optional default true; PATCH same full form plus revision. returnFeePolicy optional (NONE|ON_MERCHANT_HANDOFF), default ON_MERCHANT_HANDOFF; serviceFee liability follows feePayer.
parcelInput: merchantId,recipientName,recipientPhone,city,destination,description,pieces,codAmount required; merchantReference,secondaryPhone,latitude,longitude,instructions,weight,declaredValue,notes,scheduledAt,priority optional. Fee terms/currency snapshot from merchant. PATCH same full form plus revision; only CREATED editable. customerNotes optional, separate from internal notes.
routes: GET /merchants/business/:id/statement -> ledger list; currency?,from?,to?; parcel and settlement history via their lists merchantId filter
POST /parcels/:id/attempts {revision,outcome:FAILED|DELIVERED,reason?,note?} -> {companyId,parcel}; FAILED requires reason; records attempt and transitions atomically
GET /returns -> list return records with parcel included; status? is return stage
GET /settlements/:id -> {companyId,settlement}; settlement includes lines,payments and revision
POST /settlements/:id/payment {revision,amount,method,reference,paidAt,idempotencyKey} -> {companyId,settlement}; only FINALIZED, exact full netPayable
accounting: Collection full expected customer total = goods COD + customer-paid delivery/service fees. Only goods credit merchant. Delivery/service merchant liability debited at delivery; return fee at merchant handoff. Collection goods credit excluded from settlement until separate remittance. Immutable ledger, immutable allocated lines, signed adjustments, unique allocation. Draft reserves entries; draft cancellation releases allocation. Finalization admin only; payment separate full payout. Settlement draft cannot exceed complete eligible merchant balance even when date filters omit outstanding debits. Preview returns previewHash; draft requires matching expectedPreviewHash, otherwise409.
errors: Existing NestJS errors/wrapper; 400 validation/domain,403 capability/context,404 scoped absence,409 stale revision/idempotency mismatch/duplicate monetary action. No cross-tenant disclosures.
driver: GET /parcels/drivers -> list {id,companyId,fullName,phone,status,vehicleId}; page/pageSize/search; no auth secrets. Read by admin/accountant.

dashboard.filters: merchantId,workerId,city,status,currency,search,from,to filter the same shipment set for all metrics/activity. Dates select parcel creation dates; standalone adjustments use posting dates and are excluded under driver/city/status/search filters. Paid amount is the selected ledger lines allocated to actually paid settlements.
dashboard.definitions: expectedCod: uncollected goods on noncancelled, nonreturn shipments; uncollectedCod: delivered goods lacking collection; collectedCod: actual recorded goods collections; unremittedCash: CASH-method full customer receipts not yet remitted; CARD/BANK_TRANSFER still require independent remittance confirmation for settlement eligibility; merchantPayables: posted signed ledger minus actually paid allocated lines; settledAmounts: actual paid allocated lines.

detailExtras: GET parcel detail additionally includes allowedTransitions:string[] and capabilities object; merchant statement list includes balances by currency. worker:{id,fullName,phone,status}|null included in parcel detail. Returns list supports reason filter. DRIVER_ASSIGNED events include old/new worker id/name snapshots. Generic DELIVERED/FAILED_DELIVERY transitions persist exactly one attempt just like dedicated attempts API. Reassignment to a different driver while current custody is DRIVER requires explicit company/warehouse handback.
